connector.name: Ship24 Tracking by ship24-official
connector.registryDescription: Track any parcel by tracking number - real-time status, event history, and carrier detection.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package ship24-tracking-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ship24-official account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PLAN_PER_SHIPMENT

env.name: PLAN_PER_CALL
env.description: Set to 'true' to enable the per-call Tracking Search endpoint (for per-call plan subscribers)

env.name: SHIP24_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the Ship24 API base URL (default: https://api.ship24.com/public/v1)

env.name: COURIERS_CACHE_TTL_HOURS
env.description: How long to cache the couriers list in hours (default: 24)
